western: Regional reference: define obscurity relative to the expected awareness of an ordinary person living in the western, particularly North America and westernern Europe. Interpret everyone knows, mainstream, specialty, familiar, and rare in the criteria relative to this audience, not worldwide production or familiarity elsewhere. For foods, use typical grocery availability and everyday culinary awareness in this region as supporting evidence. An item can be common in another region and still be uncommon or obscure here. This regional context changes only familiarity, never which items belong to the category.
